data.title: Suction blister apparatus
data.summary: Miscellaneous · Suction machine or syringe assembly that raises epidermal blisters for epidermal grafting in vitiligo.
data.body:
_Also called: Suction blister set-up, Syringe suction technique_

Suction machine or syringe assembly that raises epidermal blisters for epidermal grafting in vitiligo.

## Parts
- Suction machine: suction pump, vacuum gauge, glass cup with non-traumatic rim
- Syringe technique: 20/50/100 ml disposable syringes with pistons removed, three-way cannula (Disofix), 50-100 ml syringe for negative pressure

## Types / variants
- Suction machine (250-500 mmHg)
- Syringe technique

## Uses / indications
- Raising suction blisters for epidermal (blister-roof) grafting in stable vitiligo

## Method of use
1. Clean donor site (anterolateral thigh, flexor forearm, abdomen); shave hair
2. Interconnect syringes via three-way cannulas, open ends on skin
3. Withdraw piston of the end syringe to create negative pressure; close the three-way
4. Blister forms in 1-2 h from dermo-epidermal separation

## Sterilisation & care
Glass cups must be sterilised; syringes are disposable.

## Viva points & tips
- Syringe method: cheap, less painful, no sterilisation, easy
- Blister grafts: good colour match, no pebbling; suitable for eyelids, lips, glans
- Machine: expensive, bulky, needs special cups
